reason: I already get three quotes from crews and compare the numbers myself, and a platform that picks the builder for me just adds a middleman I have no way to check. I still don't know who vets these builders or what happens to my money if the work goes wrong.
objection: Who checks that the builder is any good? A platform that promises to pick one for me has to show me the builders' track records and what it does when a job goes badly.
would_change_my_mind: Verified past work and reviews for each builder, plus payment held in escrow and released only when each stage of the job is signed off.
